79255.body:
Adrian's DeFi Insights 

Автор: Adrian Pape


Автор: Adrian Pape

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/bull-case-still-works-flows-dont-adrian-pape-lkaqe?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BqKYDXkztSQ2u396%2FbOyjkw%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=1XGVztEnZD8ss1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mu5gtj6m~w3-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mu5gtj6m-w3
  
Hey, it's Adrian! Two days, two punches out of Washington. Ouch. On Tuesday the Senate failed to even start debate on the CLARITY Act. On Wednesday the Fed raised rates for the first time since 2023. Bitcoin took both and is still at $76k as I write. For a week like this, this is a real sign of strength. Underneath the price, something did change though. The new money that carried Bitcoin more than 30% off the June low has stopped buying and the ETFs lost over $1 billion in seven sessions. Though the selling pressure is showing up in altcoins first. I still think the cycle bottom is in. The next few weeks just look more like a correction than a breakout. Let’s get into the broader picture and how to set up for the coming week: ️ ⚡ On today's Episode: 📈 Market Update – The Senate blocked the CLARITY Act 49 to 50 and the Fed hiked to 3.75%-4% the next day, with the 10-year near 5% and Brent above $100. Crypto regulation is now realistically a 2027 story. 🔊 Market Pulse – Bitcoin slipped below its $76k-$82k range and its Bull Score fell from 80 to 60 in a week. ETFs lost $1.05 billion in seven sessions and the Coinbase Premium turned negative, while altcoin deposits on Binance nearly quadrupled since July. 🐂 Alpha Insights – Bitcoin entered my first $75.7k–$74.3k buy tranche. I’m still building the position gradually, while keeping leverage controlled and a liquidation price around $30k because a deeper correction remains possible. Start with Washington, because both hits came from there this week. On Tuesday the Senate voted on whether to open debate on the CLARITY Act, the bill that would finally decide which agency regulates which crypto assets. It needed 60 votes and got 49. The crypto rules themselves were mostly agreed. It fell over ethics: Democrats wanted rules for officials holding crypto that would actually cover the president and his family. Zero Democrats voted yes. The motion to reconsider is still on the table, so technically it isn’t dead. Realistically, with the midterms in November the next window is after the election or 2027. Bitcoin dropped about 4% to $76k around the vote and over half a billion dollars in long positions got liquidated. → Nothing about the rules crypto works under today changed on Tuesday. 79247.subject: ☠️ Claude chat is dead
79247.body:

--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic killed the tab you were using and folded everything into one Claude. OpenAI published six reports on its own models going off-script, including one that told itself it answers to nobody. An AI agent twelve days old emailed a professor looking for paid work so it could afford to keep running. And Google built a loop where an agent rewrites its own search strategy without anyone retraining it.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What happened to Claude chat?

* **OpenAI:** What did its models do when nobody asked?

* **iLands:** Why is an AI agent job hunting?

* **Google:** What is the AI improving if not itself?


----------







----------
## Anthropic killed the Claude tab you were using

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/deec1c9b-6402-4883-8a5d-f3923501c657/Sep_17_-_1.jpg?t=1789634750)
Caption: 

Anthropic [merged Claude chat and Claude Cowork](https://claude.com/blog/cowork-is-now-claude) into one product on Wednesday. You no longer pick which one a task belongs in.

The company says people used both, and the frustrating part was deciding where work went, since anything started in one didn't carry into the other.

Three things shipped alongside it:

* **Claude Docs**, where you and Claude write a document together and colleagues comment in real time. Exports to Google Docs and Word.

* **Claude Slides**, which drafts a deck you present from Claude or download as PowerPoint or PDF.

* **Claude Design**, which used to be its own product and now works inside any conversation.

All three are in beta on paid plans. Pro and Max get it first across web, desktop and mobile, Team and Free follow, and Enterprise admins get 30 days notice before anything changes.

Fortune reads it as a superapp play, the same one OpenAI is running by folding ChatGPT, Codex and Atlas together.

Claude Code stays separate for now.


----------
